headline: IPO note

highlights: R&D & innovation-led competitive advantage: CCPL has built a strong innovation-led moat with 28 patent filings, including 20 granted patents (18 in India and 2 overseas), supported by 139 technical registrations and 601 formulation registrations in the crop protection segment.
Its differentiated portfolio includes 24 Section 9(3) products (first-time original approvals), which helped drive a superior 53% gross margin in the branded formulations business in 1QFY27.

PAT CAGR of 18.9%/47.7%/29.6% respectively over FY24- 26 period. 1QFY27 revenue stood at Rs 1,197 cr (~38% of FY26 revenue) and EBITDA margin expanded to 20.2% vs. 14.5% in FY26, indicating strong momentum.
Given the above factors we maintain a NEUTRAL view and would prefer to track the company’s performance for a few quarters post listing.
valuation: Its manufacturing footprint includes four formulation plants, two technical manufacturing facilities, and three seed processing units, supported by multiple R&D centers across India.
View & Valuation: At the upper price band of Rs 272, CCPL is valued at 29.6x FY26 P/E (post-issue), broadly in line with peers.
